Challenges in reporting on projected impacts concerning small and medium sized enterprises SMEs which are enabled to access renewable energy based on and as a result of GET.invest supported projects being taken up by financiers While an effort was made to estimate this impact with available data the accuracy of such estimates was found to be very low and would compromise the previously reported numbers on people with access to energy in terms of double counting. There is the lack of consistent data across countries on the number of SMEs using the same definition of what constitutes an SME. For an accurate estimate the distribution of SMEs by average energy consumption by grid vs offgrid connection would be needed. Consultation with industry players such as PowerforAll revealed that such delicate impact figures are estimated using a bottomup approach with a sizeable survey 200 being extrapolated at the country level. Weighing the significant ME costs this would entail against the still rather weak validity of the resulting information the indicator has been skipped as per the recommendation within the approved Annual Report 2022.
